items.text: Driving: do we love it because it's quick and convenient, or is it just that we don't have a choice?

level1.label: 表语从句
level1.text: that we don't have a choice

items.text: Either way, commuting by car is becoming more common across the world.
While this could mean that people are getting more mobility and freedom, could it have a cost?

level1.label: 让步状语从句
level1.text: While this could mean that people are getting more mobility and freedom

level2.label: 宾语从句
level2.text: that people are getting more mobility and freedom

items.text: As the number of cars on the road increases, so does congestion.

level1.label: 时间状语从句
level1.text: As the number of cars on the road increases

items.text: As more people travel by car, more road space is used up.

level1.label: 时间状语从句
level1.text: As more people travel by car

items.text: According to the OECD's International Transport Forum, the average person travelling in a car takes up five times as much road space as someone on a bus.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: the average person travelling in a car

level1.label: 宾语
level1.text: five times as much road space as someone on a bus

items.text: This is made worse by the fact that, on average, today's cars are larger than those of the past.
Tailbacks and other traffic jams in the UK could be costing £7.5 billion each year in wasted time.
It's not just gridlock and wasted time that's the problem.

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: not just gridlock and wasted time

items.text: Car dependency has significant health impacts.
Air pollution from diesel and petrol cars can cause health problems such as asthma and other respiratory illnesses.

level1.label: 宾语
level1.text: health problems such as asthma and other respiratory illnesses

items.text: Road traffic accidents lead to injuries and fatalities.
Additional to this are the long-term problems caused by sedentary lifestyles, leading to poor fitness and obesity.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: the long-term problems caused by sedentary lifestyles

level1.label: 状语
level1.text: leading to poor fitness and obesity

items.text: Road-building developments can also split communities, leading people to feel cut off.

level1.label: 状语
level1.text: leading people to feel cut off

items.text: Where road transport dominates an area, people without access to a car can feel isolated.

level1.label: 地点状语从句
level1.text: Where road transport dominates an area

items.text: Cities and countries are sometimes tempted to build new roads to reduce the potential for snarl-ups.

level1.label: 谓语
level1.text: are sometimes tempted to build new roads

level1.label: 状语
level1.text: to reduce the potential for snarl-ups

items.text: However, some experts say that this can cause induced demand where increased road capacity leads to more people driving, and congestion is soon back to its previous level.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that this can cause induced demand where increased road capacity leads to more people driving, and congestion is soon back to its previous level

level2.label: 定语从句
level2.text: where increased road capacity leads to more people driving

items.text: The other side of this theory is that when road space allocation is taken away from private cars, often congestion won't get any worse.

level1.label: 表语从句
level1.text: that when road space allocation is taken away from private cars, often congestion won't get any worse

level2.label: 时间状语从句
level2.text: when road space allocation is taken away from private cars

items.text: Authorities in some cities, such as Seoul and Utrecht, have demolished motorways, leaving natural features such as streams and rivers in their place.

level1.label: 状语
level1.text: leaving natural features such as streams and rivers in their place

items.text: Making drivers pay more is an approach used in cities like London, or Singapore, where ten-year car ownership licenses can cost over £60,000.

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: an approach used in cities like London, or Singapore, where ten-year car ownership licenses can cost over £60,000

level2.label: 后置定语
level2.text: used in cities like London, or Singapore

level2.label: 定语从句
level2.text: where ten-year car ownership licenses can cost over £60,000

items.text: The increased costs can help reduce the number of cars on the road and make traffic flow faster.
